integrity: The proof uses the source peripheral map, the source stable commutator-length value for \(\lambda^N\), homogeneity of stable commutator length, and the published identification of slope seminorm with stable commutator length. The bundled computation checks only arithmetic consequences.
scientific_limitations: The stable seminorm formula is complete on \(H_1(T^2;\mathbb R)\), but the exact unstable singular-genus formula is asserted only for primitive integral slopes whose tangent exponent \(a-Nb\) is divisible by \(N\). No embedded-genus claim is made.
title: Exact slope seminorm for a same-exterior family of knotted tori
